title: FYI × FLIBS – Recapping Another Successful Show
description: At FLIBS 2025, FYI Yachts showcased the Sunseeker Ocean 90, Okean 52 and Okean 57, driving high engagement and strong global brokerage interest.
html:
The halls were buzzing, the docks alive, and our team aboard three standout yachts couldn’t have been more pleased with the turnout. At FLIBS 2025, FYI Yachts returned with full force — and once again proved why we’re at the center of today’s global brokerage action.

Showcasing Three Exceptional Yachts

This year we featured three exceptional listings: the 2024 Sunseeker Ocean 90 Enclosed / Ocean 182 (“Worth the Wait”), the 2024 Okean 52, and the forthcoming 2026 Okean 57.

  • The 2024 Sunseeker Ocean 90 is a tri-deck 88-foot super-yacht combining bold design and refined comfort.
  • The 2024 Okean 52 blends performance and spaciousness in an agile 52-foot package.
  • The 2026 Okean 57—available now—brings forward the next generation of the sport-line yacht and drew plenty of interest. Putting these three distinct yet complementary yachts on display allowed us to speak to a wide spectrum of prospective buyers — from those seeking big-volume luxury to those hunting agile, performance-oriented craft.

High Energy & High Engagement

From the first morning until the show closed, traffic on our docks was consistent and energetic. Early conversations turned into serious interest, and our team logged a strong volume of meetings, follow-ups and walk-throughs. The combination of high-profile product and FYI’s global reach delivered the outcome we anticipated.

We noticed several trends first-hand:

  • Visitors keen on options for immediate or near-term delivery were particularly focused on the 2026 Okean 57, signaling appetite for new-build sport-lines.
  • The Sunseeker Ocean 90 drew a mix of clients looking for expansive volume and long-range cruising capability — a segment still very much active.
  • The Okean 52 appealed strongly to those who value performance and outdoor living, underscoring the continued appeal of well-conceived 50-60-foot designs. Overall, the show reaffirmed one clear message: a discerning buyer base remains active, informed and ready to transact when the right yacht is presented.

What This Means Going Forward

For FYI Yachts, FLIBS 2025 wasn’t just an event — it was a strategic touchpoint. The momentum we generated will carry into Q4 and beyond. With a strong roster of listings, the interest we logged at the show gives us immediate leads and pipeline strength.

Additionally, the exposure and brand reinforcement achieved by exhibiting these three different yachts under one umbrella reinforce our positioning as a full-spectrum brokerage: whether you’re looking for ultra-luxury tri-deck volume or agile sport-performance craft, we cover the span.

As we digest the leads and follow up, clients will benefit from our capacity to convert show interest into concrete opportunities. For prospects, now is a great time to engage: the show served as a reminder that the right yacht doesn’t stay “available” for long.

Looking Ahead

While we wrap up the show floor and return to our offices, the work continues. Teams are already scheduling private showings, exploring bespoke deals and lining up the next wave of opportunities. FYI Yachts remains committed to staying ahead of the curve—keeping our listings fresh, our service exceptional and our global outreach active.

If you joined us at FLIBS 2025, thank you for stopping by and sharing in the excitement. If you weren’t able to make it — let’s connect. Whether it’s one of the three yachts we showcased or something else in our global inventory, we’re ready to help you explore what’s possible.
